'''Zanbar''' was a [[Swamp/Legends|swamp]] [[Moon/Legends|moon]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]' [[Mandalore sector/Legends|Mandalore sector]]. The [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Death Watch/Legends|Death Watch]] relocated to Zanbar and established a [[Zanbar Death Watch camp/Legends|camp]] there shortly after leaving [[Carlac/Legends|Carlac]].

==Description==
[[File:Zanbar_geography.png|thumb|left|220px|The surface of Zanbar]]
The moon was covered with stretches of marshy plants and flora that was separated by large, colossal plateaus and mesas.<ref name="Encyclopedia" />

==History==
In [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]], [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]] and [[Savage Opress/Legends|Savage Opress]] allied with the Death Watch. In addition, it was here that [[Lom Pyke/Legends|Lom Pyke]], and his [[Pyke Syndicate/Legends|Pyke Syndicate]], joined Maul's [[Shadow Collective/Legends|Shadow Collective]].<ref name="EM" /> It was at this time that the camp was abandoned when the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] and the Death Watch [[Takeover of Mandalore/Legends|conquered]] [[Sundari/Legends|Sundari]], the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] of the [[New Mandalorians/Legends|New Mandalorians]] on [[Mandalore/Legends|Mandalore]] from [[Duchess/Legends|Duchess]] [[Satine Kryze/Legends|Satine Kryze]].<ref name="SOR">{{TCW|Shades of Reason}}</ref> Later on, however, the moon would be the site of a battle between the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] led by [[Grievous/Legends|General Grievous]] and the [[Shadow Collective/Legends|Shadow Collective]] led by [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]] and his associates, which ultimately resulted in the withdrawal of the latter faction and a brief Separatist occupation.<ref name="Darth Maul-Son of Dathomir 1" />
